_meta.name: recall-gold-v1
_meta.scoring: identity — the gold fact id must appear in select_recall()['included'] (the packer's injected set)
_meta.gold_definition: clean, current, prose facts (confidence >= 0.7), stratified across kinds (directive/decision/bug/architecture/correction) and dates, avoiding over-picking the 2026-05-19 backfill
_meta.queries: one topic-paraphrase query per gold fact, HAND-AUTHORED (not machine-generated), overlap-guarded against the fact's verbatim wording so recall is not trivially lexical
_meta.validity: every eval measurement is a within-subjects delta (baseline vs a technique on identical queries+gold), so query-difficulty bias cancels; the absolute numbers are a floor, not a point estimate
_meta.limitation: SYNTHETIC fixture: content and queries are generated placeholders (no real memory data) so this public repo carries no store content; regenerate via bin/scrub-recall-fixture.py, not from a live store.
_meta.regenerate_ids: ids are fixed by the committed synthetic fixture; regenerate everything via bin/scrub-recall-fixture.py, never from a live store
